channel.title: Guinea - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Guinea, every source cited.

item.title: AS Kalombada beats Alu Star with late goal
item.description: Kabiné Sakho scored in added time to give AS Kalombada a 1-0 victory over Alu Star.

item.title: 60 Conakry vigilance members trained on disaster risk
item.description: Guinea's Environment Ministry trained 60 vigilance committee members in Conakry on environmental disaster prevention.

item.title: Rio Tinto SimFer shows Simandou mine operations
item.description: Media professionals toured mining facilities in Beyla, Guinea, on October 28-29, 2026, to see ore processing.

item.title: Guinea U-15 team loses in Azerbaijan tournament quarterfinals
item.description: The Syli scolaire U-15 team was eliminated from the FIFA World Cup and Festival in Baku after a 2-1 defeat to Greece.

item.title: Guinea hosts francophone telecom regulators
item.description: Conakry meeting addresses digital infrastructure deployment and connectivity challenges.
